messages:
maria: Heads-up — QuillFinance procurement just asked for a one-page pen-test attestation plus a SOC2 excerpt for the dedicated POC. They need wording that references the dedicated POC environment and specific dates. Can we confirm what we can share and how fast?
raj: Do they want the full tester report or just an attestation/letter? Full reports need NDA and legal signoff.
sam: We can provide a signed attestation (redacted) and a SOC 2 Type II summary extract. We don't hand out raw vuln scans or full third-party reports without NDA and legal clearing.
maria: They asked explicitly for: "Statement that a pen test was done against the dedicated POC environment (staging.provision.quill) on 2025-03-10". Is that precise enough?
sam: That phrasing is fine but we should match our internal environment name; internally we log it as "POC — dedicated staging". Legal needs to approve the exact sentence. Also need to know if they want the pen tester to deliver directly or if our legal team can provide a redacted letter.
olivia: I can take legal review. We usually allow a redacted attestation naming the environment and test date. We avoid releasing exploit details. If they want the unredacted report, require NDA + direct delivery from vendor.
raj: Operationally we can also supply a sanitized network diagram and a one-page control matrix showing SSO/KMS/data residency. For artifact transfer use presigned S3 or SFTP, not email.
maria: Timeline: POC kickoff 2025-03-17. Procurement asks to have the attestation by 2025-03-14. Feasible?
sam: Tight but doable. I'll draft the attestation and ping legal @olivia here.
olivia: looping in counsel now. Draft the text here and i'll review ASAP. Note: add a line clarifying this is not a certification of compliance to any framework.
sam: Draft v1: \n"Redwood Inference hereby attests that an independent third-party penetration test was performed against the environment designated as \"POC  dedicated staging\" on 2025-03-10. Remediation for findings classified as requiring action were completed by 2025-03-13. This attestation is provided for procurement purposes and does not constitute release of the full penetration test report. Requests for the full report must be submitted under mutual NDA and approved by Redwood legal."\nmaria: Looks good. Please add a short redaction policy line and contact for receiving redacted artifacts.
sam: Draft v2: \n"Redwood Inference hereby attests that an independent third-party penetration test was performed against the environment designated as \"POC  dedicated staging\" on 2025-03-10. Remediation for findings classified as requiring action were completed by 2025-03-13. The attestation does not certify compliance with any specific regulatory framework beyond the stated testing activities. The full penetration test report may be provided under a mutual NDA; our standard redaction policy removes attacker personally-identifying information and operational secrets. Requests for the redacted report or delivery instructions should be sent to security-legal@redwood.com. This attestation is provided for procurement purposes and does not constitute release of the full penetration test report."\nraj: I'll prep sanitized network diagram + control matrix and upload via presigned S3. ETA EOD 2025-03-12.
deploy-bot: Reminder: use secure artifact transfer (presigned S3/SFTP). Do not send sensitive attachments over email.
olivia: Legal okayed the language with minor tweaks — do not name the third-party tester without vendor consent. Also clarify that custom testing requested by the customer is a billable professional services item.
maria: Procurement also asked whether dedicated pricing changes if we run an extra scoped test for them.
raj: Yes — if we perform a tailored engagement or retain logs longer for their audit, ops/prof services fees apply. I'll include an estimated one-time fee in the SOW draft.
maria: I'll ask procurement to confirm whether they want the tester to deliver directly or will accept our redacted attestation. I'll update once they respond. Thanks all :thumbsup:
